hotel_2star_room_2p.sourceTitle: The Best 2 Star Hotels in London from $44 | Expedia
hotel_2star_room_2p.evidenceText: Expedia's 2-star London trend table shows August $114. It states the trend excludes taxes and fees and is based on base rates for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days and averaged for commonly viewed 2-star properties in London.
hotel_2star_room_2p.referencePeriod: Expedia result crawled last month; trend based on base rates found in the last 7 days; August monthly value.
hotel_2star_room_2p.searchQuery: site:expedia.com London United Kingdom 2-star hotels average nightly price trend 2 adults taxes fees
hotel_2star_room_2p.reason: Accepted as source-feasibility evidence with known excluded-tax base-rate basis; it is not an inclusive product observation.
